verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no video-extension feature and no way to regenerate a single segment of a clip. The nearest items do not qualify: mask-based local re-editing is documented for Image 3.0 Omni, not video, and "multiple rounds of post-production" and per-shot multi-shot storyboarding do not describe extending or partially regenerating an existing clip. The axis clearly applies to a video generator, so the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a creator, I can extend a clip or regenerate one segment of it without re-rendering the whole video
